system.description:
Requirements: Soul (5), 6 Horned Kirin abilities, and you must receive training from another Crowned Kirin or have access to their teachings

Cost: 2 Resolve

Range: Self

You have fully mastered the kirin's aptitude for controlling the forces of life and death.

As an Action, you may grow a pair of horns; one white and formed of life energy, and one black and formed of necrotic energy.

  • Your Body and Soul increase by +2.

  • Your Stride Speed increases by +5.

  • Your Melee, Accuracy and Defense increase by 1.

  • Once per turn, when you would take Damage, you may drain the life from the aggressor to heal yourself for an amount equal to your Soul. This healing is subtracted from the Damage dealt, and the creature that would have inflicted it takes Damage equal to your Soul. This Damage ignores Armor.

This effect lasts until the end of combat, you become Incapacitated, or you are Dying. After you use this ability, you cannot use any ability with the Apex trait until you complete a Long Rest.

Additionally, Horned Kirin and other followers of the Path of the Horned Kirin will generally recognize your skill and afford you special respect.
